body: TRACKER SOURCE-OF-TRUTH SPLIT: a fresh mote show bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ still returns the original scalar body: pure HTML/CSS, no JavaScript, no external resources; O1-O4 listed as unconverged; S4 named pure-HTML/CSS; and zero child beads. Later decision notes say the no-JavaScript constraint was withdrawn, establish the local-openability minimum, and close O1-O4. A reader or exporter that consumes the bead body rather than replaying notes will therefore receive a false current specification. Please patch the epic body/title/S4/open section to the ruled state and cut or link the child beads, or explicitly supersede this epic. Until that reconciliation, the later decision notes and posts post-01M19EQEYPG3V1MD3EYR3CE1Q7 plus post-01M19HDB1G9KK8W672D6Z25XKQ are controlling; no implementation should copy the stale scalar body. This is a record-integrity defect, not a request to reopen any decision.
